title: Quesnel women's death being probed by police watchdog
subtitle: A woman who was arrested by police in Quesnel on Sunday morning has died.
article: A woman who was arrested by police in Quesnel on Sunday morning has died.
According to a media release from the RCMP, the unnamed woman and a male companion were allegedly assaulted in the 800-block of Front Street some time before 4:20 a.m. on Oct. 1.

After responding to the call, the RCMP say officers realized the assaulted woman was in breach of court-imposed conditions and placed her under arrest before transporting her to the Quesnel detachment, where she was examined by paramedics who determined she needed greater medical attention.
After further assessment at Quesnel's G.R. Baker Hospital, it was determined she needed to be transported to "a larger area hospital," the RCMP said.
The woman died Monday morning at that larger hospital.
Police are now treating her death as a homicide and have arrested two suspects.
The Independent Investigations Office is investigating the RCMP's actions in the initial assault investigation as well as the arrest to determine if they had any connection to the woman's death.
Anyone who witnessed Sunday morning's incident is asked to contact the IIO at 1-855-446-8477.
